build_MultipleLossWrapper: build a MultipleLossWrapper from a list of loss config dicts to compute multiple losses in order
run_MultipleLossWrapper_forward: run the MultipleLossWrapper forward pass with input and target tensor lists to get a list of losses
build_CombinedLoss: build a CombinedLoss from a dict of named loss config dicts for individual named loss access
run_CombinedLoss_individual: run an individual named loss from a CombinedLoss module by calling it directly with its inputs
review_loss_wrappers: review the MultipleLossWrapper and CombinedLoss classes for combining multiple loss functions in mmpose models
